spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact surfaces (Element.requestFullscreen, navigator.keyboard.lock / unlock, Element.requestPointerLock) and prints real outcomes. The pointer lock return shape (Promise vs undefined) is normalised. Each call is paired with its csd.proto trigger type.

interactive.rationale: Seven buttons: on-click and delayed (6 s, after activation expiry) variants plus an invalid-key-code lock; the live navigator.userActivation readout updates every 500 ms.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card describes exactly what the page does, including that it is a labelled model / manual observation where applicable.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers expired activation (pointer lock rejects NotAllowedError), invalid key codes (InvalidAccessError), keyboard lock outside fullscreen, an absent API, and a double-click guard on the delayed timers. Every lock is released immediately.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5094379441225728 plus the Chromium source or blog sources used.

conformance.rationale: Exercises the same contracts as the feature suite's fullscreen-needs-transient-activation and keyboard-lock-rejects-invalid-codes script assertions (both pass on Chromium 153).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 (Playwright CDP) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch. chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so there is no DevTools-MCP verification and no accessibility-tree dump. On click: fullscreen resolved with fullscreenElement equal to the section, then exited. Keyboard lock resolved inside fullscreen and was released. Pointer lock produced pointerlockchange, then exited. The invalid code rejected with InvalidAccessError. Delayed by 6 s with no intervening input: fullscreen was rejected with 'TypeError: Permissions check failed', pointer lock was rejected with NotAllowedError ('A user gesture is required'), and keyboard lock resolved with no activation (shown verbatim). No fullscreen or pointer lock remained afterwards. Activation renewed by input during the wait is detected and labelled, and the refusal assertion is skipped in that case.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the on-click success paths and the late refusal paths separately; a late fullscreen success is recorded as a failed assertion, not hidden.

design_system.rationale: Only public/styles.css tokens; buttons that override background also set color; status colours (emerald-dark, rose) used only on light backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, fieldset/legend, polite live regions and visible focus. However, the accessibility tree was not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Exercised at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both after the final edit, single-column layout on mobile, 44px targets.

openQuestions.title: Add Vibration / Clipboard / Notification trigger rows
openQuestions.detail: VIBRATION_API, CLIPBOARD_COPY_API and NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_PROMPT are also CSD trigger types; add real, safe, activation-gated rows (vibrate(0), writeText of benign text, a permission query without request).

openQuestions.title: Check headed Chrome's press-and-hold Esc UI
openQuestions.detail: Headless cannot show the 'press and hold Esc' bubble shown under keyboard lock; capture it in headed Chrome.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live polite for standard status updates, reserve assertive for critical ones; label every control; visible focus; 24px+ targets (bumped to 44px here).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Readouts and verdicts are aria-live polite (never assertive); all inputs are inside <label>; :focus-visible 3px outline; buttons/labels min-height 44px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Gate powerful capabilities on explicit user activation; never chain them to unrelated interactions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All primary calls run inside click handlers; the delayed variants exist only to demonstrate the browser refusing expired activation, and results are printed verbatim.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep fullscreen UI functional and provide a clear exit.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Fullscreen is exited programmatically right after the result is recorded; the page tells users Esc always exits.

summary: Real activation-gate demonstration of the APIs scam pages abuse, with immediate release.
